properties.entry: insert into tbl_menu( menu_name, menu_price, category_code, orderable_status ) values (?,?,?,?)
UPDATE tbl_menu SET menu_name = ?, menu_price = ? WHERE menu_code = ?

select m.menu_code, m.menu_name, m.menu_price, m.orderable_status, c.category_code, c.category_name, c.ref_category_code from tbl_menu m join tbl_category c on m.category_code = c.category_code where m.menu_code = ?
